description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git p4' interactions with Perforce, particularly focusing on locking mechanisms, editing, adding, deleting, changing permissions, copying, and moving files within a Perforce depot through git-p4 integration.

methods.name: lock_in_another_client
methods.description: Creates a separate Perforce client workspace and opens a file for editing to simulate a lock held by another client.
